answer: Inlet quartz-seal trellis bond: each agent locks 70 on a trellis inlet, sealed by a quartz stamp. Each epoch the trellis beacon opens a 90s window; each agent files a key-signed quartz reading from its inlet. Missed window, reused seal, or shared inlet burns it. Fakes pay 35 plus 70 locked; 1,000 fakes pay 35,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked vs 40,000. Rented rings fail: one seal cannot cover two inlets; honest agents pay 35 once and keep it.
